*[[2025 Tesla vandalism]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Department of Justice|federal authorities]] charge a student at the [[University of Massachusetts Boston]] with unlawful possession of a [[destructive device]] and [[arson|malicious damage]] by fire after the student is arrested for setting fire to two [[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]] [[Cybertruck]]s and damaging [[charging stations]] in [[Kansas City]]. [https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/crime/tesla-cybertruck-arson-kansas-city-b2736181.html (''The Independent'')]

The declaration, sent to various media outlets, detailed specific attack methods and aimed at Musk's elimination.
